releases.title: Production launch of reviewed Version 2 board
changes: Promote reviewed 2.5.1 features to production. Redirect the default Netlify production address to the canonical domain so the existing account/privacy boundary is consistent. Google account sync and owner report writes remain staged on preview.

releases.title: Internship sharing and Version 2 overview
changes: Give internships specific themed share pages and images with fresh availability checks, and share the readable Jobs detail layout.
Restore first-card artwork on both boards and refine the Latest Update notes and dismissible welcome toast.
Present eight major Version 2 features with the exact current version while preserving full private release history.

releases.title: Keep saved jobs across devices
changes: Added a one-time Google sign-in reminder after a successful new guest bookmark, using the existing application reminder design and a separate browser receipt. It yields safely around other notes, does not stack with the first Saved shortcut, and keeps the existing three-application reminder and later Saved shortcut cadence.
Updated the privacy disclosure for the new reminder marker and confirmed Nic’s three-part numbering choice for 2.5.0 and future patch carries.

releases.title: Cleaner Latest Update cards
changes: Removed the decorative brown tape above the four Latest Update cards on desktop and mobile. The miniature theme swatches retain their tape, and the four title arrows and existing announcement behavior are unchanged.

releases.title: Clearer Latest Update card links
changes: Replace Click here with a decorative drawn arrow after each Latest Update card title; remove duplicate orange arrows inside the advice and internship previews. Existing announcement receipts, interaction, data flows and four-card order are unchanged.

releases.title: Keep owner restoration available after Undo expires
changes: Add owner-only Reported jobs to Board menu, using the existing authenticated private read and guarded restore action. Keep only removed posting fields in memory, preserve stable retry IDs and global revision conflicts, and retain keyboard navigation.

Includes the accepted 2.4.6 compact header, second-card drawings, pointer-focus correction and preview moderation. Native recovery tests cover 320, 390 and 1440px; no new server powers, storage recipients or retention. Production unchanged.

releases.title: Complete preview runtime packaging
changes: Fix the Edge method declaration and separate unchanged source parsing from image generation. All seven Netlify Functions packages and the Edge package validate; all seven emitted handlers cold-load with credentials and network absent.

807 tests pass. Includes compact board header, second-card drawing, accessible pointer and keyboard dialogs, reversible owner-only preview reporting, privacy disclosures and security corrections. Earlier 2.4.3 and 2.4.4 stayed local; 2.4.5 failed host packaging and was never served.

public.title: A little more room for the roles
changes: A compact board header brings roles closer, with the drawings still along for the hunt.
Clearer mobile dialogs and a more reliable way to keep listings current.

releases.title: Finish owner reporting and compact board QA
changes: Final keyboard browser check caught native disabled-button blur during Undo. Preserve action focus ownership and return focus on success or retry without taking later user focus.

Includes compact header, second-card art, pointer-focus correction, server-authorized preview unlisting, policy updates, dependency and local-launcher fixes from the undeployed2.4.3/2.4.4 candidate checkpoints.803 tests pass; bounded native keyboard/click/retry/expiry and all-theme checks completed.

releases.title: Preserve keyboard access to report undo

Includes the compact header, second-card illustration, reversible owner reporting and privacy/security corrections prepared in 2.4.3. Earlier 2.4.3 seal remained local and was never deployed.

unpublishedPublicDraft.title: A little more room for the roles
changes: The board starts closer to the controls, with the drawings still along for the hunt.

releases.title: Compact board and owner reporting

Add authenticated reversible preview-only owner reporting with durable acknowledgments and active-listing checks.
Preserve keyboard focus while removing automatic pointer-focus outlines; restrict local preview to loopback and update privacy disclosures.

unpublishedPublicDraft.title: A little more room for the roles
changes: A more compact board header brings the first roles closer.
Small improvements to mobile dialogs and listing availability.

releases.title: Keep Tracker status messages readable in every theme
changes: Final hosted 2.4.1 review found an inherited Casino Tracker sync-caption contrast defect: dark inherited ink on burgundy. Bind only that status paragraph to existing Tracker theme ink; bump account.css cache references.

All 744 tests pass. Ten rendered caption checks cover eight themes at390px plusOriginal/Casino1440px, each above4.5:1. No change to status, Saved, auth, storage, analytics, policies, data, sounds or creators. Preview only.

public.title: A clearer Tracker message
changes: Tracker save and sync messages now stay readable in every theme, including Casino.

releases.title: Saved reminders and steadier mobile navigation
changes: Add a current-owner device-only Saved shortcut after successful new bookmarks 1,5,10; coordinate with other reminders and preserve saved records.
Preserve native Tracker selects through status changes and sync echoes; clear suspended previous-account views before showing board or Tracker state.
Clear Saved-only views on section navigation; put count left and Board menu right with protected illustration spacing; normalize known single-office city/state and trailing hourly plus.

Latest Update adds current version at footer left and removes only the static heading outline. Privacy discloses bookmark cadence and tab section storage. Sound effects and creator subsections remain deferred; preview only.

public.title: A smoother board on your phone

Tracker status changes stay steady, and switching sections opens the full board again.
Shorter location labels and clearer spacing keep job cards easier to scan.
Latest Update now shows the current version at the bottom.

releases.title: Compact multi-location job cards

Verified all 162 current location labels, 34 affected listings, same-state offices, DC, remote alternatives, address notes, city aliases and ZIP codes.

public.title: A little more room on every job card
changes: Jobs with several locations now say Multiple locations. Open the job for the full list of cities.

releases.title: Fit shared job text and provide the browser icon

public.title: Clearer shared job cards

releases.title: Hosted theme navigation and share-image correction
changes: Make generated theme-page navigation root-relative so hosted pretty URLs preserve Home and board routes.

public.title: A smoother trip around the board
changes: Theme links take you to the right place, and shared job cards keep their star.

releases.title: Clearer sign-in and a calmer first visit

Label Google sign-in on mobile and offer a one-time reminder after three newly saved guest applications. Preserve verified QA owner exclusions and surface analytics service configuration failures accurately.
Replace the application nudge with a Tracker sticky note, enlarge mobile bookmarks, compact About Nic, prevent internship stamp overlap and align counts away from doodles.

Remove salary preference from discovery ordering, preserve ordering after feed refresh, update Privacy and Terms, and correct small-text contrast across board and Tracker surfaces. Sound effects remain deferred outside the website.

public.title: A clearer board, from the first visit

Larger save buttons, a smaller About note and clearer internship cards make phone browsing easier.
The latest updates appear before you start browsing and stay available in Board menu.
Higher pay no longer decides which roles appear first.

releases.title: Keep filter panels above the closed board menu

public.title: Clearer filters

releases.title: Readable actions across every theme

public.title: Clearer actions in every theme

releases.title: Keep your place, with clearer internship cards
changes: Preserve account-owned public saved-card snapshots and backfill existing bookmarks from retained retired Jobs rows. Confirm closure only from exact Dead evidence; missing or cross-board saves stay distinct and never disappear silently.

Simplify the internship pay filter and labels, use a stable diverse decorative paper cycle, add full-contrast Internship stamps, enlarge bookmarks and remove redundant Pay Details in job popups while retaining raw source data.

Use one lined help note at a time, remove Tracker help and Google Preferred Sources promotion, move State first, close filters on outside taps, put About Nic in Board menu, open notebook preferences without input focus and remove Clear answers.

Keep newsletter iframe nodes through background refresh, render the form as it arrives, replace external fallback with inline retry; shrink advice art, randomize appropriate open notes, suppress notes in hidden review, and show themed feedback for five seconds with four-second wider toasts.

Exclude the verified QA account from measurement and closure reports. Creator Version 3 experiment stays paused and separate; open-note, Portfolio Graded CTA and Lexend mockups remain private review artifacts.

public.title: Your saved jobs stay with you

Internships have shorter pay labels, varied paper colors and their own stamp. Bookmarks are easier to tap.
Smaller theme previews, clearer menus and quieter notebook popups make browsing easier on your phone.

releases.title: Mobile polish and quieter discovery
changes: Remove feed signup promotions; actual job-detail openings show signup every second time, with a reserved loading state and direct fallback. Every published advice ID has artwork and quieter invitation copy.

Render the real board before current feed resolves, preload local fonts and remove skeleton placeholders. Preserve typed filters, unavailable-feed recovery and no cached catalog. Remove automatic dialog focus outline and correct inherited body font.

Use a one-line tracker reminder after the first and every tenth newly stored application. Top-right tracker removal opens a No-default confirmation with keyboard wrapping and account guards; notes grow without an extra toggle and Export is nearly straight.

Public style guide retains visual brand sections; full prior guide is privately archived. Public HTML and JSON explicitly project two viewer-facing releases while the full ledger remains internal. Privacy describes local cadence counters. Retain Board menu while alternate More placement awaits feedback.

public.title: A little less in your way
changes: A smaller tracker reminder, clearer delete confirmation and notes that grow as you type.
More illustrated advice and fewer newsletter invitations while you browse.
Smoother page loading, cleaner job popups and a shorter visual style guide.

releases.title: A quieter board, clearer pay
changes: Move preferences, hidden jobs, suggestions and what’s new into one Board menu. Preferences open by request; the returning-job introduction is deferred.
Simplify Latest Update, redraw the tracker preview, use white internship paper and keep every arrow drawn.
Use compact whole-number pay labels with exact employer amounts under Pay details, and one list of 50 state names on both boards.
Show one lined-paper tooltip at a time and keep menu and dialog focus predictable.

public.title: A quieter board, clearer pay
changes: Find preferences, hidden jobs, suggestions and what’s new in one Board menu.

public.title: Internships have a place on the board

The update waits 30 seconds, remembers dismissal, and is always available through What’s new.

releases.title: Keep each account’s place its own

releases.title: A clearer board, with better recovery
